text: Squad session today, first time keeping up with Lasse the whole way. Good day.
Still buzzing from yesterday. Emil says I paced the run leg perfectly.
Cold snap this week. Everyone in the squad feeling it, not just me.
Trained the coast loop alone this morning. Used to always have someone at the end of it.
Three magpies before the bridge again this morning. Good sign, kept it to myself. Would never tell Freja and Lasse I still do this.
Cold all the time lately. Layering up for sessions in weather that never used to bother me.
Coach wants the volume down a notch for a few weeks. Fine by me, legs have been heavy anyway.
Skipped again. Third month now. Not writing anything else about it.
Everything feels heavy even on the easy days. Can't remember the last one that felt light.
Foot thing has a name now. Not running for a while. Hate this part.
Hop test finally clean. Fifteen in a row, no twinge. Easing back carefully this time.
Didn't go to camp this year. Told the squad it was money. Wasn't only that.
